parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The names of the security policies. You can specify up to 10 names
parameters.help_zh: 安全策略名称列表，最多支持10个
parameters.name: security_policy_names

parameters.help_en: The security policy IDs. You can specify at most 20 security policies
parameters.name: security_policy_ids

element_fields.help_en: The tag key. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
element_fields.name: value
